text: I've been waiting ages for the call back so I'm just going to text it. Looking after my nephew tonight, he's 6 months. He's had runny poos, three today. BUT he's feeding fine, taking his bottles no problem, and his nappies are wet like normal. He's wide awake, babbling away at me, grabbing at everything. My sister wants to know if she needs to do anything about the poos or just keep an eye. Would be nice if someone actually got back to me
